title: Sunday · seventeen flyers
logline: The flyer wall at seventeen, the week of the thirtieth derby. The strip counts by drawing. Barnaby, fifteen, asleep against the wall's foot.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the shingle wall with seventeen crab flyers in a row, 1998 to 2014, and at its foot an old dog asleep in the one patch of February sun.

image.prompt: a shingle wall with seventeen hand-lettered crab flyers in a row and an old dog asleep at its foot in a patch of winter sun, no words legible

panels.name: Wall

panels.composition: Tier 2: the middle of the row: 2006's four crabs, 2011's baby scribble, the hands changing.

image.prompt: two crab flyers side by side on a wall, one with four crabs and one with a child's scribble beside a crab, no words legible

panels.name: Middle

panels.composition: Tier 3: the patch of sun moved off the dog onto the wall. The dog still asleep. Held.

image.prompt: an old dog asleep at the foot of a wall as a patch of winter sun moves off him onto the shingles, no words

panels.name: Sun

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Seventeen. The sun moves off the dog.
